skill.summary: AI agent for call academic search agent tasks

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — sets strict research and reporting protocols for academic search tasks.

- Enforces "user input as absolute truth" and prioritizes user requests over internal knowledge.
- Implements stepwise research workflow: preliminary planning, logging, parallel searching, and authoritative source review.
- Mandates use of Google Scholar as primary search tool; restricts calls to only permitted tools.
- Establishes strict limits and compression on research logs and reports (max 5000 words each).
- Requires verbatim quotes for cited literature and prohibits language inference from system prompts.
- Introduces mechanisms to halt unproductive research loops and ensures efficiency with academic honesty.
